reason: Conversation 2 correctly infers from 'half the house' that it is the RCD, gives an accurate ranked diagnosis (fan element earth leakage once hot), interprets the grill result sensibly, proposes the low-risk defrost (fan-only) test, helps with the SI6 model identification, and escalates to an engineer/electrician for insulation testing with justified-after part advice.
